page.heading: CEREC same-day crowns.
page.summary: A strong, natural-looking crown designed, made and fitted in a single visit. Less waiting, fewer appointments, more time getting on with life.
page.imageAlt: CEREC dental technology in the Tarbert Street Dental practice

sections.title: Your new crown, without the waiting room.
paragraphs: CEREC uses digital scanning and precision milling to create a beautiful ceramic crown while you are here. We can match the shape and shade to your smile, then bond it in place before you leave.
There is no temporary crown to manage and no second appointment weeks later. Just one calm, carefully planned visit with your usual dental team.

cards.title: One appointment
cards.text: Designed and fitted in the same visit, so your schedule stays simple.

cards.title: Natural result
cards.text: High-quality ceramic shaped and shaded to look at home in your smile.

cards.title: Less waiting
cards.text: No temporary crown and no return trip to finish your treatment.

cards.title: Clear advice
cards.text: We explain your options and make sure you feel comfortable at every step.

callToAction.title: Let’s talk it through.
callToAction.text: We can tell you whether CEREC is right for your tooth and your goals.

page.heading: Root canal treatment.
page.summary: Gentle, thorough care to relieve pain and save a damaged or infected tooth, so you keep your natural smile.
page.imageAlt: Illustration of a tooth in cross-section showing the cleaned and sealed root canals inside it

sections.title: What is root canal treatment?
paragraphs: When decay or injury reaches the soft pulp inside a tooth, it can become infected and painful. Root canal treatment removes the infected pulp, cleans and shapes the inner canal, and seals it to stop infection returning, saving the tooth rather than removing it.

We know root canal treatment has a reputation, so we take extra care with anaesthetic and pacing, especially for anxious patients. Most people are surprised at how comfortable the appointment is compared to what they expected.

sections.title: It may be time to call us.

cards.title: Persistent tooth pain
cards.text: Especially pain that lingers after hot or cold food.

cards.title: Swelling or tenderness
cards.text: Gums that are swollen, sore, or tender to touch nearby.

cards.title: Darkening tooth
cards.text: A tooth that looks darker than those beside it.

cards.title: Save your natural tooth
cards.text: A far better outcome long-term than extraction.

cards.title: Numb & assess
cards.text: The area is fully numbed and we take an X-ray to see the canal shape.

cards.title: Clean & shape
cards.text: The infected pulp is removed and the canal is cleaned and shaped.

cards.title: Seal & restore
cards.text: The canal is sealed and the tooth restored, often with a crown for lasting strength.

callToAction.title: Let’s make a plan.
callToAction.text: Call us or send a message and we’ll find a time that works.
